notes.title: Night Of The Dead is approaching!
Update 1.1 is now live!
Update 1.1 is now open for testing!
notes.content: Hi, Earlgrey here. It's been a month since release and now im proudly present first major update to the game! It includes battles on ships, more activity while traveling on the sea overall, new dungeons, spells, monsters and much more. Since new changes need to be tested, update will be put on "Unstable" branch for a few days. Full list of changes will be released along with update itself. Stay tuned!

notes.title: Bugtracker
notes.content: Despite the fact that I(and several main testers) are constantly searching for bugs in the game, I need your help! If you have discovered a bug, this is the right place to tell about it.
